UiPlanWorkflow.title: Fleet plan wizard
UiPlanWorkflow.subtitle: Step-by-step: create a one-day plan, assign drivers and vehicles, add deliveries, preview routes on the map, confirm, then download reports.

stepHints.0: Pick organization, service date, time zone, work plan template, and a depot storage (route start). Then create your fleet plan.
stepHints.1: Ensure each active driver has a vehicle assignment for route generation.
stepHints.2: Import Excel or add stops manually. Service date defaults to your plan day.
stepHints.3: Choose clustering strategy and polygon style, generate draft routes, then open the map to preview.
stepHints.4: Lock the plan when the preview matches what you want. Re-open here if you must adjust.
stepHints.5: Review counts and download fleet PDF, per-driver PDFs (ZIP), or JSON instructions.
